title: EquityResearchSchema
description: Schema for the agent-authored research block stored at context/data/equities/<TICKER>.json under the 'research' key. This block is the system of record for every qualitative judgment and every forward-looking parameter in the repository. Deterministic scripts read this block and must never author, infer, or substitute a default for any field defined here. Shared field shapes are referenced from investment_thesis_schema.json rather than redefined.

symbol.description: Primary stock ticker symbol. Must match the enclosing file name.

schema_version.description: Version of this research block schema.

description.description: Concise 1-2 sentence company business description used on grid cards and in universe.json.

moat_summary.description: Single-clause moat summary used in compact universe records.

tam_and_market_share.description: Agent-estimated total addressable market. Scripts compute market-share arithmetic from tam_estimate_usd_b but must never estimate the TAM itself.

tam_estimate_usd_b.description: Estimated total addressable market in billions of USD.

tam_cagr_pct.description: Underlying market annual growth rate percentage.

narrative.description: Market size, competitor landscape, share defense, and adjacent-segment expansion.

valuation_parameters.description: Forward-looking parameters the agent supplies to valuation_model.py. Without this object a ticker receives no valuation, no ROI, and no rating.

annual_revenue_growth.description: Modeled annual revenue growth rate as a decimal (0.28 = 28% per year).

target_ps_multiple_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the current P/S multiple to reach the 3-year target multiple. Below 1.0 models multiple compression.

annual_share_dilution_rate.description: Net annual change in diluted share count as a decimal. Negative indicates net buyback.

dividend_profile.description: Agent-researched dividend policy. A recorded status of NONE means the agent determined the company pays no dividend, which is distinct from the field being unauthored.

capital_strategy.description: Capital allocation posture and narrative. Numeric balance sheet inputs (debt, cash, CapEx) are read from Tier 1 filings by scripts and are not authored here.

stock_based_compensation.description: SBC run-rate, vesting architecture, and lock-up dynamics. Every value here is a research finding from filings or proxy statements, never a sector heuristic.

off_balance_sheet_and_contingent_liabili.description: Forensic audit of pension/OPEB, environmental remediation, mass torts, and purchase commitments. Conforms to context/strategy/off_balance_sheet_liabilities_framework.md. An absent block means unaudited, not zero.

invalidation_criteria.description: Per-company exit triggers. Criteria shared verbatim across many tickers indicate boilerplate rather than research and are reported by the duplicate-boilerplate audit.

latest_catalyst.description: Single-sentence summary of the nearest-term catalyst, used in compact universe records. Distinct from catalyst_timeline, which carries the dated, revenue-bridged entries.

revenue_drivers_narrative.description: Explanation of what drives the 13-quarter revenue path. Scripts render the matrix; the agent explains it.

valuation_ps_multiple_narrative.description: Explanation of the P/S multiple trajectory and why the modeled return justifies the rating.

provenance.description: Authorship and source attribution, required on every authored field per AGENTS.md section 6.

authored_by.description: Agent role that authored this content (e.g. 'Investment Thesis Agent', 'Equity Research Agent').

authority_tier.description: Source authority per context/sources/catalog.md. Content written from model weights without external tool verification must be marked TIER_4_AGENT_PARAMETRIC_KNOWLEDGE.

source_locator.description: URL, SEC accession number, or filing reference supporting the content.

runtime_context_signature.description: For TIER_4 content: system clock timestamp, active role persona, and prompt context at authoring time.
